title: Contains every keyword
description: Decide whether a text contains every keyword of a list. A keyword matches when it occurs anywhere inside the text, also in the middle of a longer word, and upper and lower case letters are treated as the same. The keywords are never empty. An empty keyword list is always satisfied, even for an empty text.
notes: Substring (not whole-word) matching and case folding are the traps; the empty list is vacuously true. Keywords are never empty.
